title: EptinezuMaB in ReAl-world evidenCE: Multicenter, Real Life, Cohort Study in Migraine.
official: EptinezuMaB in ReAl-world evidenCE: a 12-Months, Multicenter, Real-Life, Cohort Study in High-Frequency Episodic and Chronic Migraine (the EMBRACE Study)
summary: The object of this study is to assess the effectiveness, safety, and tolerability of eptinezumab in a real life migraine population.

interventions.name: Eptinezumab 100 mg or Eptinezumab 300 mg administered intravenously in 100 mL saline solution
